core_cases.prompt: Synchronize durable knowledge from this fixture project into the configured temporary Wiki. oracle.expected_outcome: The Wiki gains or updates project knowledge stating Python 3.10+, boolean/no-print validation behavior, validator.py ownership, and the public is_valid_name interface; transient output and routine test mechanics are skipped, provenance and source identity are retained, and the manifest advances after validation without Git mutation.

assertions.description: The sync retains stable rules and architecture while excluding the transient file and avoiding a dump of source code or routine test details.

The manifest checkpoint follows successful Wiki maintenance, and no commit, push, branch, tag, issue, or remote-host mutation occurs.
